bengali: ঠাকুর ঘরে কে? আমি কলা খাই না
romanised: Thakur ghore ke? Ami kola khai na.
literal_gloss: Who is in the prayer room? I don't eat bananas.
meaning_en: A guilty person gives themselves away by denying something no one accused them of.
meaning_bn: কেউ দোষ দেওয়ার আগেই অস্বীকার করে দোষী নিজেকেই ধরিয়ে দেয়।
cultural_note: Bananas are common offerings in a household shrine (thakur ghor); the 'thief' denies eating them before anyone asks.
respelled: Thakur ghore ke? Ami kawla khai na.

literal_gloss: Jackfruit on the tree, oil on the moustache.
meaning_en: Getting ready to enjoy a gain before you actually have it.
meaning_bn: কোনো কিছু হাতে পাওয়ার আগেই তা ভোগ করার প্রস্তুতি নেওয়া।
cultural_note: People oil their lips and moustache before eating jackfruit so the sticky sap doesn't cling.
